_scope.brief: art-drop/BRIEF-10.md Part 8: 48x48 transparent landmarks for six families, all four seasons; inherited global style and applicable QC.
checks: Inspected every target at nearest-neighbour 8x on a full-cell checkerboard; no target was cropped.
Viewed all six ordered seasonal grass contexts at 1x and family style contexts at 4x, beside the approved out markers and complete named house references where present.

Viewed each family random 8x2 grass composite at 1x and 4x: four seasonal panels, every index appearing twice in each panel; assessed cell-edge collisions, grid effects, repeat, silhouette, palette and legibility.

Compared all named reference family markers, approved out markers, approved round-2 examples, all seasonal paddies, and all eight grass/plains details against their bases. These are comparison material only.
Checked exact dimensions, alpha, bounding boxes, bottom-centre placement, edge pixels, cluster clarity, light direction, setting fit, within-season distinctness, and nonblank coherent winter snow.
Rechecked revised towers and mills together at 1x/4x; rechecked all four fantasy mills together at 8x on their seasonal grounds.

not_applicable.3x3_target_base_tiling: Part 8 contains no base files; do not review unrelated bases as targets.
not_applicable.peak_lattice_or_range: Part 8 contains no peaks. Egg-crate mountains are outside this scope.
not_applicable.trees_composited_in_forest: Part 8 contains no trees. Flat orange autumn and identical crowns are outside this scope.
not_applicable.craters_ruins_cyberpunk_ground: Part 8 contains no crater, ruins or cyberpunk ground tiles. Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins and stamped ground grids are outside this scope.

_scope.technical_result: All 192 files are nonempty 48x48 RGBA with binary 0/255 alpha and bottom-centred placement. No blank winter, blur, antialiasing, visible fringe, halo or clipped target edge found.
_scope.visual_result: Apart from the four explicitly failed fantasy mills, the tested targets retain distinguishable roles and readable silhouettes on seasonal grass, with compatible setting palettes and lighting. No concrete new defect warrants revoking an unchanged prior pass. Identical structures across seasons are acceptable for stationary landmarks; each winter has a visible seasonal treatment.

evidence_key.ordered: Summer, spring, autumn, winter rows; indices 0..7 across; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.random-8x2: Four seasonal 8-column, 2-row stress panels; each index twice; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.edges-8x: One full-cell checkerboard atlas per family and season, all eight files; nearest-neighbour 8x.
evidence_key.style-context: Approved out markers and complete named houses beside target seasons; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.references: All named reference markers and approved out markers; 1x/4x. Complete houses are on style-context sheets.
evidence_key.all-terrain-details: All seasonal grass/plains details 0..7 and paddies, on approved bases; comparison only; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.revised-mechanisms: Revised tower and mill pairs by family and season; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.fantasy-mills-detail-8x: Remaining failures together on seasonal grass; nearest-neighbour 8x.

_scope.out_integrity: SHA-256 of every PNG in art-drop/out/ matches the pre-review snapshot; no output art was edited.

fantasy.findings: Watchtower repair passes: continuous legs, readable diagonal brace, separate ladder and coherent snow cap. Four mills still fail because their lower sails merge into their walls.

wuxia.findings: The repaired watchtower has open negative space, continuous supports and an identifiable ladder. The mill now has a clear rim, hub and four large wheel openings beside a quiet wall; the wheel remains identifiable at 1x in every season. Palette and upturned roof language fit the markers.

jazz_age.findings: Repaired watchtower beams and ladder remain legible at 1x. The windpump now has an organized radial rotor, distinct tail, open supporting frame and separate tank. Snow stays on upward-facing clusters without breaking the mechanism.

modern.findings: All 32 prior passes are byte-unchanged and retained. Full 8x inspection and seasonal grass stress layouts reveal no concrete new defect.

scifi.findings: Both revised statue failures pass: the raised arm is connected, the floating hook is gone, and a leg visibly meets the pedestal. Winter caps preserve the body. The existing cyan hologram fits the setting and is not treated as a palette clash.

wasteland.findings: Watchtower legs and braces now read separately from the patched cabin. The broad scrap vanes form a legible rotor and remain distinct from the sign/totem silhouettes; the material midtones no longer collapse to black. The winter statue has continuous body and limb shapes with limited snow caps. Rough scrap edges remain intentional and match the markers.

fail.name: fantasy-landmark-4
fail.problems: The rotor is cleaner than in r108-1, but the lower two ochre sails merge into the cream tower: below the hub their inner edges disappear into the wall, forming one broad triangular patch across the building. This is visible in the 1x grass layout and explicit at 8x; it reads like an X painted onto a flat house rather than four sails turning in front of it. Separate each lower sail from the wall with a contrasting material value and a one-pixel edge or cast shadow, add a distinct hub, and keep the tower wall visible between the sails. Give the wall a restrained shadow plane consistent with the top-left-lit roof. Preserve the repaired four-way geometry; do not reintroduce the old tangled blades.
